items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: But, uh, he asked me, did I want to go, and I started to go against my mother's wishes

ctx.x: No, I know, but I mean, uh. Fif hundred to fifty-two, about? Fifty-two, yeah. But I mean, uh, the reflexes are gone, you know. Oh yeah, in some respects you're losing.

And, now, most interest I have, the most interest I have in that little girl, my sister is teaching her to play since October. She has her playing almost a whole song of Mighty Like a Rose, since October. Yeah. And I'm fighting her too, see, because I mean, the little I know about it, I'm helping her. Yeah. But, uh, I'll tell you, I'll tell you, what I wanted to do, if I could have done it, I would like to have gone away with a big bang. I was crazy about it one time, because after I got, uh, found out I could…
